description: This plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of various Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) methods as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)." and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains six distinct data series, five of which include both a solid line with circular markers showing values across the x-axis and a corresponding dashed horizontal line. The "DPR w/o query" series is represented by a solid black line with no markers, remaining constant horizontally at approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis. The "DPR w/ gold" series is shown as a solid yellow line with circular markers; it begins below the y-axis minimum of 33.0 at x=1, crosses 33.0 near x=4, and rises steadily to end at approximately 34.95 at x=10. The "DPR w/ top-1" series features a solid green line with circular markers, starting below 33.0 at x=1, rising sharply to approximately 34.7 at x=2, and continuing to increase to a final value of approximately 36.4 at x=10; it is accompanied by a dashed green horizontal line at approximately 34.65. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" series uses a solid purple line with circular markers, starting at approximately 34.75 at x=1, peaking slightly at 35.05 at x=3, and gradually declining to 34.7 at x=10, with a corresponding dashed purple horizontal line at approximately 34.9. The "DPR w/ random" series is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 34.75 at x=1, rising to 35.15 at x=2, and remaining relatively steady to end at 35.3 at x=10, alongside a dashed blue horizontal line at approximately 35.2. Finally, the "DPR w/ curriculum" series is shown as a solid red line with circular markers, starting at approximately 35.15 at x=1, increasing to 35.55 at x=2, and gradually rising to end at approximately 35.8 at x=10, paired with a dashed red horizontal line at approximately 35.6.
